device.modelDescription: Main-thread validation fixture (test/sandbox/41): on request, its worker turns off its own validation where module code can reach it.

actionList.name: take
actionList.description: Counts a run and returns its input's n.

actionList.name: give
actionList.description: Returns a valid output, or one its schema refuses.

actionList.name: count
actionList.description: How many times take ran, and whether this worker's own validation has been turned off.

actionList.name: tamper
actionList.description: Turns off this worker's own validation where module code can reach it.

actionList.name: slow
actionList.description: Its input's pattern passes every check made at load and still takes seconds on a crafted value: the validator's deadline refuses it.

actionList.name: stall
actionList.description: Its input's uniqueItems over many objects outlasts any validation deadline: queued calls behind it time out unsent.

actionList.name: big
actionList.description: Returns an output of n characters, for the output size cap.

actionList.name: odd
actionList.description: Answers values structured clone carries and JSON does not; a function inside when kind is 'function' (test/sandbox/42).

actionList.name: forge
actionList.description: Answers {ok: true} but posts hand-made bytes through its worker's send path (test/sandbox/42).
